answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29605 Country: AU Title: I want to ask about praying Duhr and Asr, Maghrib and Isha together if there is any rain. In Melbourne, in my university, some brothers some times pray Maghrib and Isha together if there is rain. As I am Hanafi, I do not join with them when they pray Isha just after Maghrib. Sometimes, many of the present people join and when I see there might be no person in Isha, then I pray Isha alone later. So, my question is, being a Hanafi, can I join the Jamat if I see most of them are praying and there may not be an Isha Jamat afterwards. Question: Salam. I want to ask about praying Duhr and Asr, Maghrib and Isha together if there is any rain. In Melbourne, in my university, some brothers some times pray Maghrib and Isha together if there is rain. As I am Hanafi, I do not join with them when they pray Isha just after Maghrib. Sometimes, many of the present people join and when I see there might be no person in Isha, then I pray Isha alone later. So, my question is, being a Hanafi, can I join the Jamat if I see most of them are praying and there may not be an Isha Jamat afterwards. Jazakallah Khair. Answer ID: 29605 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 429/240/D=1432) According to Ahnaf, it is not lawful to offer any salah before its time combining with other salah even in case of excuse too. Hence, in the said case you should not join them in Isha salah rather you should offer Isha salah in its time. If there is no way to offer it with jama'ah, offer it alone. إن تاخير الصلاة عن وقتها من الكبائر ؛ فلا يباح بعذر السفر والمطر كسائرالكبائر عن ابن عباس: من جمع بين صلاتين فى وقت واحد فقد أتى باباً من الكبائر (اخرجه الترمذى والحاكم) بدائع 1/328 زكريا Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
